conbody.p: With the vehicle is in DRIVE READY, select SettingsVehicleDriver assistanceDriving safetySEA (Safe Exit Assist) on the infotainment system.

note.p: If SEA (Safe Exit Assist) is deselected, the driver cannot get help from Safe Exit Warning. Always drive with care.

When the trailer’s connector is plugged into your vehicle, Safe Exit Warning automatically turns off. In this case, you cannot get help from Safe Exit Warning. Pay extra attention when you drive when the function is inactive. (If a Kia genuine Trailer Kit that can determine whether a trailer is connected is used)
If the vehicle is turned off and restarted, Safe Exit Warning will maintain the last setting.
